title: Russian — scholarly (scientific) transliteration
authority: Scholarly convention (Slavic linguistics); no single issuing body
description: International scholarly system used in Slavic linguistics, based on Czech/Croatian orthography: Ж→Ž, Х→X, Ц→C, Ч→Č, Ш→Š, Щ→ŠČ, Й→J, Ю→JU, Я→JA, Э→È, Ъ→ʺ, Ь→ʹ.
notes: Х is x in modern usage (older works: ch); Э is è (some authors ė). Pre-1918: Ѣ→ě, І→i, Ѳ→f, Ѵ→i.
iuliia's JSON outputs Cyrillic ё for Ё (data bug); this scheme uses Latin ë (U+00EB).
samples: Юлия, съешь ещё этих мягких французских булок из Йошкар-Олы, да выпей алтайского чаю
Julija, sʺešʹ eščë ètix mjagkix francuzskix bulok iz Joškar-Oly, da vypej altajskogo čaju
